notes: Runs the repo's one-way and two-way MANOVA on driver-training scores (PROC DISCRIM homogeneity test + PROC GLM/MANOVA on Training and Training*Reactions). Original read Drivers from an SPSS .sav import; this bundle builds an equivalent 40-row Drivers dataset in-line, sampled from the repo's own DriversLicenseData.csv. Fixed one script typo (CLASSES -> CLASS, the documented PROC DISCRIM statement name) so it parses; all PROC logic and options are otherwise unchanged.
